src/Cluckwork.Api/Endpoints/ClientErrors.name: Screen crash reports
src/Cluckwork.Api/Endpoints/ClientErrors.description: Receives a note from the web app whenever a screen crashes, so the operator hears about it without anyone sending a screenshot.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Endpoints/CluckworkEnd.name: Address groups and access rules
src/Cluckwork.Api/Endpoints/CluckworkEnd.description: Sets up the groups of web addresses under /api/v1 and says which roles may use each group.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/Modules/Cluckw.name: Farm feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/Modules/Cluckw.description: Switches on each farm feature area (sales, flocks, inventory and so on) when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/Modules/Cluckw.name: Shared platform setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/Modules/Cluckw.description: Starts up the shared plumbing every feature relies on, such as repeat-request protection and encryption keys for sign-in data.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Sign-in cookie handling
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Stores the long-lived sign-in token in a protected browser cookie that page scripts cannot read, and clears it on logout.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Sign-in addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Defines the sign-in, sign-out, password change and two-step verification addresses and attaches the strict attempt limits.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Login handling
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Checks a person's email and password, or their second-step code, and starts a session.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Password change handling
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Lets any signed-in person change their own password after proving the current one.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Session handling
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Keeps people signed in by renewing their session, ends it at logout, and issues a short-lived confirmation for sensitive admin actions.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.name: Two-step verification handling
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Au.description: Lets a person turn on two-step verification, see its status, get new recovery codes, or turn it off.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Lo.name: Login input check
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/Lo.description: Rejects login requests with missing or absurdly long email or password text before they are tried.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/St.name: Password re-check input check
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Auth/St.description: Rejects an over-long password on the "confirm it is you" step before it is tried.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Me/MeEn.name: Own profile addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Me/MeEn.description: Lets a signed-in person read their own profile, set their language and number-stepper preference, and manage apps they connected.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/C.name: Consent choices
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/C.description: Holds which permissions a person ticked when approving an outside app.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/O.name: Connect outside apps
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/O.description: Lets outside apps, such as AI assistants, ask for permission, register themselves and receive an access token.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/O.name: Required app permission
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/OAuth/O.description: Says an outside app's token must hold at least one of a set of permissions to be let in.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Users/U.name: User management addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Users/U.description: Lets an Owner create staff accounts, edit them, change roles, reset passwords, disable people and assign flocks to workers.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Users/U.name: User two-step reset
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Access/Users/U.description: Lets an Owner clear another person's two-step verification when they are locked out.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Catal.name: Product catalog addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Catal.description: Lists, adds, edits and switches on or off the egg products a farm sells, plus the egg-count unit conversions.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Comme.name: Sales feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Comme.description: Switches on the products, customers and sales features when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Custo.name: Customer addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Custo.description: Adds, lists, views and edits customers, including their contact details.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Sales.name: Payment addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Sales.description: Records and voids customer payments, lists payments per order and shows what each customer still owes.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Sales.name: Sales order addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Commerce/Sales.description: Creates sales orders, edits their lines, then confirms, cancels or voids them and lists the order book.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.name: Daily egg entry addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.description: Records a day's egg count per flock, submits it, and lets managers correct or void it afterwards.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.name: Egg grade addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.description: Lists, adds, edits and switches on or off the egg size or quality grades.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.name: Egg operations registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.description: Switches on the daily entries, egg grades and stock features when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.name: Egg stock addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/EggOperations/.description: Shows egg stock by grade, the batches behind it and their movements, and records a movement of eggs.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.name: Farm account addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.description: Shows the farm's details and lets an Owner change its settings and the connected-apps switch.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.name: Farm banner addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.description: Uploads, shows and removes the farm's banner image.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.name: Farm logo addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/Accounts/.description: Uploads, shows and removes the farm's logo, checking and cleaning the image first.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/FarmModul.name: Farm feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Farm/FarmModul.description: Switches on the farm account, logo and banner features when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Finance/Expens.name: Expense addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Finance/Expens.description: Lists, records and corrects expenses and manages expense categories, for Owners and Managers only.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Finance/Financ.name: Finance feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Finance/Financ.description: Switches on the expenses feature when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/FlockManagemen.name: Flock feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/FlockManagemen.description: Switches on the flock management feature when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/FlockManagemen.name: Flock addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/FlockManagemen.description: Creates, lists and edits flocks, records birds added or lost, and closes, archives or reactivates a flock.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.name: Inventory feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.description: Switches on the feed and supplies inventory and water usage features when the server starts.

POST /api/v1/client-errors.name: Report screen crash
POST /api/v1/client-errors.description: Accepts a crash report from the web app so the operator can see that a screen is failing.

POST /api/v1/auth/login.name: Sign in
POST /api/v1/auth/login.description: Checks email and password and starts a session, with a strict limit on attempts.

POST /api/v1/auth/login/second-factor.name: Sign in with second step
POST /api/v1/auth/login/second-factor.description: Finishes sign-in for people with two-step verification by checking their code.

POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.name: Renew session
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.description: Swaps the sign-in cookie for a fresh session so people stay signed in.

POST /api/v1/auth/logout.name: Sign out
POST /api/v1/auth/logout.description: Ends the session and clears the sign-in cookie, even if the session has already expired.

POST /api/v1/auth/change-password.name: Change own password
POST /api/v1/auth/change-password.description: Lets any signed-in person set a new password after entering the current one.

POST /api/v1/auth/step-up.name: Confirm it is you
POST /api/v1/auth/step-up.description: Re-checks the current password and gives a short-lived approval for sensitive user-admin actions.

DELETE /api/v1/auth/two-factor.name: Turn off two-step verification
DELETE /api/v1/auth/two-factor.description: Turns off the signed-in person's two-step verification.

GET /api/v1/auth/two-factor.name: Two-step status
GET /api/v1/auth/two-factor.description: Says whether two-step verification is on for the signed-in person.

POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/start.name: Start two-step setup
POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/start.description: Begins setting up two-step verification and returns the key to scan into an authenticator app.

POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/confirm.name: Confirm two-step setup
POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/confirm.description: Finishes setup once the person enters a valid code, and gives recovery codes the first time.

POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/recovery-co.name: New recovery codes
POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/recovery-co.description: Replaces the person's backup recovery codes with a fresh set.

GET /api/v1/me.name: Get own profile
GET /api/v1/me.description: Returns the signed-in person's name, role, language and farm basics.

PUT /api/v1/me/language.name: Set own language
PUT /api/v1/me/language.description: Saves the person's preferred language; open to every role.

PUT /api/v1/me/stepper-unit.name: Set number stepper step
PUT /api/v1/me/stepper-unit.description: Saves how much the plus and minus buttons change a number for this person.

GET /api/v1/me/connected-apps.name: List my connected apps
GET /api/v1/me/connected-apps.description: Shows the outside apps this person has connected.

DELETE /api/v1/me/connected-apps.name: Disconnect my app
DELETE /api/v1/me/connected-apps.description: Removes an outside app this person had connected.

GET /api/v1/oauth/authorize.name: Start app approval
GET /api/v1/oauth/authorize.description: Sends a person to the screen where they approve an outside app.

POST /api/v1/oauth/token.name: Issue app token
POST /api/v1/oauth/token.description: Trades an approved code for an access token that the outside app can use.

POST /api/v1/oauth/register.name: Register an app
POST /api/v1/oauth/register.description: Lets an outside app register itself so it can later ask for approval.

POST /api/v1/users.name: Create user
POST /api/v1/users.description: Lets an Owner add a staff account with a role.

GET /api/v1/users.name: List users
GET /api/v1/users.description: Shows everyone with an account on the farm.

PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/password.name: Set user password
PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/password.description: Lets an Owner set someone's password without the old one, since there is no email reset.

PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/role.name: Change user role
PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/role.description: Changes what a user is allowed to do.

PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/email.name: Change user email
PUT /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/email.description: Changes the email a user signs in with.

POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/disable.name: Disable user
POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/disable.description: Stops a user from signing in without deleting them.

POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/enable.name: Enable user
POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/enable.description: Lets a disabled user sign in again.

DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/two-facto.name: Reset user two-step
DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/two-facto.description: Lets an Owner clear another person's two-step verification.

GET /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-assign.name: List worker flocks
GET /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-assign.description: Shows which flocks a worker is assigned to.

POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-assig.name: Assign flock to worker
POST /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-assig.description: Gives a worker access to a flock.

DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-ass.name: Remove flock from worker
DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/flock-ass.description: Takes a flock away from a worker.

GET /api/v1/users/connected-apps.name: List farm connected apps
GET /api/v1/users/connected-apps.description: Shows every outside app connected on the farm.

DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/connected.name: Disconnect a user's app
DELETE /api/v1/users/{id:guid}/connected.description: Lets an Owner remove an outside app a user connected.

GET /api/v1/products.name: List products
GET /api/v1/products.description: Shows the egg products the farm sells.

POST /api/v1/products.name: Add product
POST /api/v1/products.description: Adds a new egg product to the catalog.

POST /api/v1/products/{id:guid}/deactiva.name: Deactivate product
POST /api/v1/products/{id:guid}/deactiva.description: Hides a product so it can no longer be sold.

POST /api/v1/products/{id:guid}/activate.name: Activate product
POST /api/v1/products/{id:guid}/activate.description: Makes a hidden product available to sell again.

GET /api/v1/egg-unit-conversions.name: List egg unit conversions
GET /api/v1/egg-unit-conversions.description: Shows how many eggs each selling unit, such as a dozen, counts for.

PUT /api/v1/egg-unit-conversions/{id:gui.name: Edit egg unit conversion
PUT /api/v1/egg-unit-conversions/{id:gui.description: Changes how many eggs a selling unit counts for.

POST /api/v1/customers.name: Add customer
POST /api/v1/customers.description: Adds a customer with name and contact details.

GET /api/v1/customers.name: List customers
GET /api/v1/customers.description: Shows the customer directory, which holds personal contact details.

GET /{id:guid}/payments.name: List order payments
GET /{id:guid}/payments.description: Shows the payments recorded against one sales order.

POST /{id:guid}/payments.name: Record payment
POST /{id:guid}/payments.description: Records money received against a sales order.

POST /api/v1/payments/{id:guid}/void.name: Void payment
POST /api/v1/payments/{id:guid}/void.description: Cancels a recorded payment; reserved for managers so sales staff cannot cancel their own.

GET /balances.name: List customer balances
GET /balances.description: Shows how much each customer still owes.

POST /api/v1/sales.name: Start sales order
POST /api/v1/sales.description: Creates a new sales order for a customer.

POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items.name: Add order line
POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items.description: Adds a product line to a sales order.

PUT /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items/{itemI.name: Edit order line
PUT /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items/{itemI.description: Changes the quantity or price of a line on an order.

DELETE /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items/{it.name: Remove order line
DELETE /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/items/{it.description: Takes a line off a sales order.

POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/cancel.name: Cancel order
POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/cancel.description: Cancels an order that has not been confirmed.

POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/confirm.name: Confirm sale
POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/confirm.description: Confirms the order, which takes the eggs out of stock.

POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/void.name: Void sale
POST /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}/void.description: Undoes a confirmed sale; admin only.

GET /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}.name: Get sales order
GET /api/v1/sales/{id:guid}.description: Shows one order with its lines and totals.

GET /api/v1/sales.name: List sales orders
GET /api/v1/sales.description: Shows the order book with totals.

POST /api/v1/daily-entries.name: Record daily entry
POST /api/v1/daily-entries.description: Saves a flock's egg count for a day.

POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/sub.name: Submit daily entry
POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/sub.description: Finalizes the day's entry so the eggs enter stock.

POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/adj.name: Correct daily entry
POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/adj.description: Fixes a submitted entry and updates stock and bird counts; admin only.

POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/voi.name: Void daily entry
POST /api/v1/daily-entries/{id:guid}/voi.description: Cancels a daily entry and reverses its effects; admin only.

GET /api/v1/egg-grades.name: List egg grades
GET /api/v1/egg-grades.description: Shows the egg grades, such as small, large or cracked.

POST /api/v1/egg-grades.name: Add egg grade
POST /api/v1/egg-grades.description: Adds a new grade; admin only.

PUT /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}.name: Edit egg grade
PUT /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}.description: Changes a grade's name or low-stock warning level.

POST /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}/deacti.name: Deactivate egg grade
POST /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}/deacti.description: Stops a grade being used for new entries.

POST /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}/activa.name: Activate egg grade
POST /api/v1/egg-grades/{id:guid}/activa.description: Brings a deactivated grade back into use.

GET /api/v1/stock.name: Get egg stock
GET /api/v1/stock.description: Shows eggs available per grade and flags those below their warning level.

GET /api/v1/stock/lots.name: List egg batches
GET /api/v1/stock/lots.description: Shows the batches of eggs behind the stock totals.

GET /api/v1/stock/lots/{id:guid}/movemen.name: List batch movements
GET /api/v1/stock/lots/{id:guid}/movemen.description: Shows every addition and removal for one batch of eggs.

POST /api/v1/stock/lots/{id:guid}/moveme.name: Record egg movement
POST /api/v1/stock/lots/{id:guid}/moveme.description: Records eggs taken out of or put into a batch, for example breakage.

GET /api/v1/account.name: Get farm account
GET /api/v1/account.description: Shows the farm's name, currency, timezone and language settings; open to every role.

PUT /api/v1/account/settings.name: Update farm settings
PUT /api/v1/account/settings.description: Saves changes to the farm's settings.

PUT /api/v1/account/connected-apps.name: Switch connected apps
PUT /api/v1/account/connected-apps.description: Lets the Owner turn outside-app connections on or off for the farm.

PUT /banner.name: Set farm banner
PUT /banner.description: Uploads a new banner image, within a size cap.

GET /logo.name: Get farm logo
GET /logo.description: Returns the farm's logo; open to every role.

PUT /logo.name: Set farm logo
PUT /logo.description: Uploads a new logo, within a size cap.

GET /api/v1/expense-categories.name: List expense categories
GET /api/v1/expense-categories.description: Shows the categories expenses are filed under.

PUT /api/v1/expense-categories/{id:guid}.name: Edit expense category
PUT /api/v1/expense-categories/{id:guid}.description: Changes a category's name or status.

GET /api/v1/expenses.name: List expenses
GET /api/v1/expenses.description: Shows recorded expenses; Owners and Managers only.

POST /api/v1/flocks.name: Add flock
POST /api/v1/flocks.description: Creates a new flock with its starting bird count.

GET /api/v1/flocks.name: List flocks
GET /api/v1/flocks.description: Shows flocks; workers see only those assigned to them.

GET /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}.name: Get flock
GET /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}.description: Shows one flock with its current bird count.

PUT /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}.name: Edit flock
PUT /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}.description: Changes a flock's details; admin only.

POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/deplete.name: Mark flock depleted
POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/deplete.description: Closes a flock whose birds are all gone.

POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/archive.name: Archive flock
POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/archive.description: Moves a finished flock out of the active list.

POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/movements.name: Record bird movement
POST /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/movements.description: Records birds added or lost, which changes the flock's count.

GET /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/movements.name: List bird movements
GET /api/v1/flocks/{id:guid}/movements.description: Shows the history of birds added or lost.
